description:
Goal
Make the ordinary warm fz2 build consume the sibling runtime archive directly and make every post-codegen AOT phase observable.

Signal
Telemetry ends at 33.8 ms but warm wall time is 110-120 ms. link_aot_artifact always calls locate_runtime_staticlib, which spawns cargo build -p fz-runtime --release --message-format=json just to rediscover the sibling archive, then spawns cc. FZ_AOT_RUNTIME_STATICLIB pointing to the same target/release/libfz_runtime.a reduces builds to a stable 60 ms; Cargo discovery alone costs 40-50 ms. cc/object/archive/link work has no telemetry.

Strategy
At the build/install boundary, retain or deterministically derive the exact sibling runtime artifact path once instead of asking Cargo on every compilation. Preserve the isolated coverage-build rule and explicit override. Add spans for object emission, runtime archive resolution (including source), linker invocation, and total build/front-door time. Do not add a process-global stale path cache.

TDD
Pin that a normal sibling plan performs no Cargo invocation, coverage still selects a clean isolated archive, and an override validates its path. Observe link-stage telemetry in the CLI build integration test.

Acceptance
- Warm ordinary builds spawn no Cargo process for archive lookup.
- Coverage and packaged-binary behavior remain correct.
- Telemetry accounts through command completion/link.
- Docs/tests/clippy pass.
title: Remove Cargo rediscovery from ordinary AOT archive selection and span the link
